name: ZL Compressor
about:
A multi-mode dynamics compressor with clean and vintage styles, a sidechain filter, and a clear level meter that shows gain reduction over time.

Released under AGPL-3.0 by ZL Audio.
notes: Windows and macOS installers are used (MSI runs with msiexec /qn; the macOS build is the Intel x86-64 DMG, which also runs under Rosetta on Apple Silicon).
